episodes.title: Facciamo amicizia!
episodes.overview: Ashiya Mizuki is a girl but she attends an all-boys school because high jumper Sano Izumi is there.

episodes.title: Voglio stare con lui
episodes.overview: The school doctor Umeda and Sano figure out that Mizuki is a girl. Can she continue staying at the school?

episodes.title: Non mi arrenderò!
episodes.overview: After Sano stops his friend Rika from slapping Mizuki and yells at Rika, Mizuki and Sano get into a fight.

episodes.title: Una personalità vivace!
episodes.overview: Sano decides to rejoin the track team, but then his old rival Kagurazaka shows up to provoke him.

episodes.title: C'è qualcuno che mi odia?
episodes.overview: Sano doesn't seem to remember the last night, but Mizuki also has other troubles: someone has it out for her.

episodes.title: Arriva mio fratello!
episodes.overview: Mizuki's brother Shizuki unexpectedly comes to Japan. Can she keep keep her secret while he's here?

episodes.title: Perché io sono un ragazzo!
episodes.overview: Dorm 2 is being renovated, so Mizuki needs a place to stay for 2 weeks. Desperate, she turns to Umeda...

episodes.title: Anche se non possiamo diventare amanti
episodes.overview: Tamami is all over Sano, putting Mizuki into a strange mood about her and Sano's relationship.

episodes.title: Va bene così?
episodes.overview: Io asks Mizuki if she wants things with Sano to stay this way. Later, Mizuki is in danger!

episodes.title: Vestirmi da donna non mi si addice!
episodes.overview: It's festival time for Osaka High. The winning dorms gets special privileges, so things get heated.

episodes.title: Senpai Nanba?
episodes.overview: Dorm 1 plays dirty in the chicken fight against Mizuki's team. Later Nanba has a heated exchange with a woman.

episodes.title: È proprio strano
episodes.overview: Sano's jumping well, and he seems happier. Nakatsu's still confused about Mizuki, but then a girl asks him out?!

episodes.title: Fammi diventare più forte, pe favore!
episodes.overview: Even though Nakatsu is dating Komatsu, he can't stop thinking about Mizuki. Meanwhile, Mizuki starts karate...

episodes.title: Come hai fatto a capirlo?!
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor arrives before the school trip, turning Mizuki's daily life upside down.

episodes.title: Ti aspetterò
episodes.overview: Everyone is enjoying the trip to Hokkaido. But Sano is lost in thought and wanders off, so Mizuki follows him.

episodes.title: I Can't Not Think About It
episodes.overview: During her midnight bath, Mizuki runs into Sano. Shaken by this, she can't look him in the eyes the next day.

episodes.title: It's Fine, Right?
episodes.overview: Julia's worried that someone might find out that Mizuki is a girl. But then Sano's words rock her to the core.

episodes.title: Because I Want to Stay by Your Side Forever
episodes.overview: The picture of Sano, Nakatsu, and Nanba goes viral with girls. A fashion photographer is also interested.

episodes.title: Teacher's Boyfriend?
episodes.overview: Akiha talks the gang into doing a test shoot. He's a good photographer, but is he also Umeda's boyfriend?

episodes.title: Don't Look!!
episodes.overview: The photos turned out great, but Sano's not interested in modeling. So Akiha tries to convince Mizuki.

episodes.title: Did You Do It?!
episodes.overview: Someone sabotaged the shoot and destroyed the photos. So now they're doing a shoot on location.

episodes.title: What Do You Want?
episodes.overview: The joint Christmas ball with St. Blossom is coming up, but Mizuki ends up having to learn the girl steps?

episodes.title: It Can't Be Helped
episodes.overview: Mizuki wants to dance with Sano, but Nakatsu jumps in and asks her to partner with him.

episodes.title: I'm So Happy!
episodes.overview: Somehow Nakatsu faints and Mizuki's dress gets ruined at the ball. Can she still dance with Sano?
